scope: 23 static main-city NPC redraws; no animation or client integration
approvalAppliesTo: paid API/CLI route only; builtin artwork remains authorized
userSteering: Preserve and merge the original Q-version Taoist style with image/designs.
All NPCs should convey Spring Festival / Mid-Autumn festive character.
stylePriority: existing user-approved designs art and original Q-version Taoist identity
each existing NPC face, age, profession, proportions and primary colors
character-specific festive costume and accessory details
apiPlanNote: Historical proposal only. Paid API explicitly declined; do not execute proposedApiParameters. All actual new generation uses built-in host with no model/quality/size selectors.

entries.name: 杨镖头
entries.festiveTreatment: Vermilion brocade collar/cuff accents and a coordinated hair ribbon; warm-gold moon/cloud roundels with small osmanthus embroidery; one coherent belt cluster containing a red ruyi knot, moon-rabbit jade pendant and tiny lantern charm.

entries.name: 屠娇娇
entries.festiveTreatment: A small red ribbon woven into the teal feather headpiece; delicate warm-gold osmanthus edging; a small moon-rabbit sachet suspended from a short red knot at the waist. Keep teal dominant.

entries.name: 董老头
entries.festiveTreatment: A modest crimson cloth belt with one handmade knot; restrained warm-gold osmanthus stitches along the brown robe edge; a small full-moon jade bead charm. Keep the elderly everyday character.

entries.name: 辛仁皑
entries.festiveTreatment: Warm-gold reunion roundels integrated into the reddish robe; a neat vermilion tassel below the teal belt; a small moon-shaped jade ornament. Preserve his merchant character.

entries.name: 北斗星使
entries.festiveTreatment: Warm-gold full-moon and cloud motifs within the purple robe edging; a red auspicious knot on the staff below the grip; a tiny osmanthus-embroidered belt pouch. Preserve the existing red shawl.

entries.name: 赤灵尊神
entries.festiveTreatment: A short red silk knot at the polearm shaft; restrained warm-gold moon-and-cloud engravings on selected armor edges; a small jade moon pendant at the belt. Keep blue-silver armor dominant and avoid heavy added gold armor.

entries.name: 擂台管理员
entries.festiveTreatment: A red auspicious waist knot with short tassels; warm-gold reunion/cloud embroidery on blue sleeves; a small moon jade plaque. Keep the folded-arm silhouette clear.

entries.name: 阵营战表彰大使
entries.festiveTreatment: A neat red ceremonial ribbon on the sword sheath; small warm-gold osmanthus motifs at the official collar; one compact full-moon jade pendant at the belt.

entries.name: 镇魔道人
entries.festiveTreatment: A vermilion knot on the fly-whisk handle; warm-gold moon-and-cloud embroidery framing the existing Taoist motifs; an osmanthus-embroidered small gourd pouch. Keep yellow-orange dominant.

entries.name: 车夫
entries.festiveTreatment: A practical red cloth waist tie with one small knot; a few golden osmanthus stitches at the teal collar; a tiny moon-rabbit fabric pouch. Keep decoration modest and suitable for everyday work.

entries.name: 无想僧
entries.festiveTreatment: A short red cord knot tucked at the waist; subtle warm-gold full-moon and osmanthus embroidery at the robe hem. Keep the prayer hands unobstructed and the monk dignified.
entries.actualPrompt:
Production redraw: 无想僧 — a single complete static main-city NPC for 五行奇谈.

STYLE LOCK — The primary art reference is the user-approved image/designs style sheet, reference 1. Preserve its bright, clean, rounded and full-bodied Chinese hand-painted chibi finish, subtle painterly material volume, soft warm lighting, warm ivory, jade accents and refined matte gold. Merge this with the project's original Q-version Taoist fantasy art direction. The user explicitly requires BOTH this existing art style and clearly welcoming Chinese Spring Festival / Mid-Autumn celebration. Festive costume detailing must grow naturally from each role. Preserve original character-specific dominant colors, age, occupational identity, rounded face, short limbs and compact proportions. Do not replace the cast with uniform red-and-gold holiday costumes; do not stretch the body to fill a portrait canvas.
Reference 2 is THIS NPC's existing design: preserve its face, pose, major garment shapes, hairstyle, signature prop, age and silhouette. Reference 1 remains the primary art-style authority. There are only TWO image references; the specific festive treatment is described below.

IDENTITY INVARIANTS
Wuxiang monk: bald gray-bearded elder in brown-orange robes, hands in the original prayer pose. Preserve his particular eyebrows, beard outline, peaceful face and compact silhouette.

FESTIVE INTEGRATION
A short red cord knot tucked at the waist; subtle warm-gold full-moon and osmanthus embroidery at the robe hem. Keep the prayer hands unobstructed and the monk dignified.
Use two or three organized groups of festive detail, clearly visible but harmonious. Maintain substantial calm fabric areas and refined material handling. Ornament scale must suit short rounded chibi bodies and remain readable at gameplay size.

IMAGE REQUIREMENTS
Highest available native-detail repaint; use a portrait 4:5 canvas at the highest native detail available through the built-in host. Preserve short compact chibi proportions. Fit the ENTIRE figure and all props inside with 8 percent clean transparent padding on every side. Rebuild natural hair locks, cloth folds, embroidery, warm jade and matte-metal details at native output resolution. Full body and every prop inside frame, roughly 6–8% transparent safety margin, balanced central composition following the original three-quarter camera. True transparent alpha PNG. One character only. No floor, platform, ground shadow, scenery, UI, labels, watermark, frame or fake checkerboard. No new text; preserve any existing occupational glyph only if part of the original prop. No neon glow, plastic shine, gritty texture, confetti, generic repeated faces, added limbs or cropped weapons. Keep all identity invariants while allowing the specific festive trims and small accessories above.

entries.name: 无意僧
entries.festiveTreatment: A small red auspicious knot at the robe fastening; a softly gold-edged full-moon medallion woven into the brown robe and a tiny osmanthus motif on a simple waist pouch. Keep prayer hands unobstructed.
